descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A4 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Text contrast below WCAG AA in several places (survey button 3.66:1, Previous Notes header 2.5:1, dashboard room line)

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-13/S22, TC-20/S18, TC-25/S21

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S24a Baseline survey card on the Hospital and Nursing Home lists passes axe on desktop and phones

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 A one-time baseline survey is shown before the physician adds their first patient (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 2; TFA-94514 AC 4; TFA-94609 AC 7)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane profiles desktop, Pixel 7, iPhone 15 on a fresh account (baseline card on the lists)

When axe on /rounding and /snf with the baseline card (the visual lane's hospital-list and nh-list screens)

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations on the card; Start survey and Not now have accessible names and are reachable by keyboard; tap targets >= 24 px and no sideways scroll on phones

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core violations (serious/critical) = 0; accessible-name and tap-size checks from visual-checks.ts (evidence for a human per visual-lane). Only these two screens: the dialogs, Settings and Nursing Home Post-Round are S24b

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S24a is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Accessibility · environment local · tickets TFA-94514 ready for qa; TFA-94609 ready for pr

The 'Start survey' button on the baseline survey card is white on teal at 3.66:1, below the 4.5:1 contrast required, on both the Hospital and Nursing Home lists.

Evidence: allure be679cfc-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/OAT-06_S24a: 22 checks pass, 6 fail (a serious axe color-contrast violation on desktop, iPhone 15 and Pixel 7). Names, Tab reach, tap size and no sideways scroll pass.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: visual.

UAT item: OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-06/S24a

Baseline survey card on the Hospital and Nursing Home lists passes axe on desktop and phones

Tickets: TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa); TFA-94609 Pilot Surveys (ready for pr)

New local lane visual: status failed in visual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: yes): lists.spec.ts: fresh account without the baseline snooze; axe scoped to the baseline card on /rounding and /snf; Start survey / Not now names; Tab reach (desktop, Pixel 7); tap >= 24 px and no sideways scroll on phones.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 22 judged check(s) passed, 6 failed.

Product issue: The 'Start survey' button on the baseline card is white on teal-600 (3.66:1, needs 4.5:1) — a serious axe contrast violation on the card on both lists (oracle: serious/critical = 0). Names, Tab reach, tap size and no sideways scroll pass.

Evidence: 5 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/OAT-06_S24a — a folder (15 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev; the baseline card also needs an account that has not answered the baseline, which the shared dev account cannot be made into.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
